description:
Found investigating fz-sc8.238. A map whose struct module atom is computed at run time (Map.put(m, :__struct__, String.to_atom("Elixir.S"))), or picked among written modules, named a module no type names. So the schema was absent: the map printed as a map, and missed S's defimpl (Protocol.UndefinedError), where Elixir prints %S{...} and dispatches.

Rule (user approved 2026-11-18 via Callables; page https://claude.ai/artifact/Phar2f3mC1XWeftr8tNZB8): a program carries the struct schema of every module whose atom it can hold.
- A runtime-root executable adds the modules whose atoms its body writes.
- The fz_binary_to_atom extern (behind String.to_atom) adds every nameable module.
- Macro roots add neither.
This supersedes option B (a type trigger on __struct__), which failed the gate because is_struct, is_exception and %{__struct__: m} patterns give the same type.

The user approved the distiller pin rises: requests (46,264, 46,552, 26) → (46,265, 46,553, 26); derivations 19,564 → 19,576; reads handed 155,014 → 155,045.

Done when: oracle fixture 01766 prints such a map as %S{...} and dispatches it to S's defimpl, on interp, run and build. PR #769.

comments.text: Investigation (Callables, 2026-11-18): the gap is wider than printing: a map given a computed struct module also misses its protocol implementation (Protocol.UndefinedError "not implemented for S (a struct)" where Elixir dispatches), on interp and run. Page with options A (carry every declared struct: ~6 jobs per unused struct module, 27 in library, nearly every work pin rises) / B (carry them only when a reachable type has __struct__ as an unknown atom; misses a variable key) / C (document and close): https://claude.ai/artifact/Phar2f3mC1XWeftr8tNZB8 (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.242.html). Awaiting the user; Callables recommends B.

Option B's trigger failed the full gate (Callables, 2026-11-18); nothing is committed. The types cannot tell building a map from testing one. is_struct, is_exception and a %{__struct__: module} pattern all yield the same '__struct__ is some atom' type, so ordinary programs trip the trigger: quicksort reads every library module, and six pins rose. What works once schemas are present: printing, defimpl dispatch, and Range as 1..3 (fixture 01766 passes on three paths). The page now carries a correction and two replacement triggers: B1 at build sites (literal, update, Map.put with key :__struct__) and B2 a library clause. Callables recommends B1. Awaiting the user's ruling.

title: A map whose struct module is known only at run time prints and dispatches as that struct
